ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, point C is a point on line segment AB, point D is the midpoint of line segment BC, and $AB=16\,cm$, $CD=3\,cm$. If point E is on line AB, and $AE=2\,cm$, what is the length of line segment DE in $cm$?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} Given that $AC=10\,cm$, $CD=3\,cm$, \\
it follows that $AD=AC+CD=10+3=13\,cm$. \\
When point E is to the left of point A, denoted as $E_1$, $DE_1=AD+AE_1=13+2=15\,cm$. \\
When point E is to the right of point A, denoted as $E_2$, $DE_2=AD-AE_2=13-2=11\,cm$. \\
Therefore, the length of segment DE is either \boxed{11\,cm} or \boxed{15\,cm}.
